R373.evidence_tier: co-product verified against KEGG R12351 and all PE-donor EtNP transfers in map00563 (2026-10-21); the gene assignment is a KEGG ortholog call, not experimental validation; mass balance not checkable (GPI intermediates have no formula and the model DAG formula C6H8O6 is not a diacylglycerol)
